## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL regime. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed sector performance (Energy, Technology, Materials positive vs. Healthcare, Communication, Industrials negative) and moderate leadership concentration with large 1W/1M divergences among megacaps (multiple major names show 1W ≠ 1M), supporting a neutral stance.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: SLB (1W: +6.63% | 1M: +8.21%) ABOVE TREND; Technology leads: AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND; Consumer Staples positive: WMT (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +5.57%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Communication lagging: CHTR (1W: -23.87% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND; Healthcare lagging: JNJ (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -5.18%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Discretionary lagging: TSLA (1W: -6.07% | 1M: -2.50%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +20.59% | 1M: +40.84%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND, NUE (1W: +9.40% | 1M: +30.18%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Moderate concentration (3 sectors represented: Technology, Materials, Healthcare).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: COF (1W: -7.30% | 1M: +3.33%) CORRECTION, IBM (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -3.90%) BELOW TREND, HON (1W: -8.73% | 1M: -5.59%) BELOW TREND, DHR (1W: -8.99% | 1M: -5.09%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -9.76% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND; weakness concentrated in select Industrials and Tech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +20.59% | 1M: +40.84%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR divergence across large caps (META, JPM, V/MA show 1W vs 1M mismatches) — tactical watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Technology overall positive with strong winners: AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +3.27% | 1M: +16.56%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +0.31% | 1M: +7.30%) ABOVE TREND; however corrective action in some mega-caps (META CORRECTION) creates mixed internal leadership.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials soft this week: JPM (1W: -0.65% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION, COF (1W: -7.30% | 1M: +3.33%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -2.40% | 1M: +1.48%) CORRECTION — 1M gains contrast with 1W weakness, so monitor for confirmation before adding exposure.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare lagging with notable outlier UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND while JNJ (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -5.18%) BELOW TREND and DHR (1W: -8.99% | 1M: -5.09%) BELOW TREND show broad sector pressure.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Maintain balanced positioning and favor recent 1W/1M confirmed leaders (select Technology and Materials names) while reducing exposure to structurally weak Communication and lagging Healthcare names; style mixed / no clear leadership given moderate concentration and major divergences — monitor for trend confirmation before expanding risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +20.59% | 1M: +40.84%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through.  
BEARISH: CHTR (1W: -23.87% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -13.30% | 1M: -17.74%) BELOW TREND — risk of continued downside.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Technology and Energy (both showed solid 1W gains within a mixed breadth backdrop).  
BEARISH: Healthcare and Communication (1W weakness and negative news catalysts warrant monitoring).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA for hold of the 1M uptrend and volume confirmation to extend ABOVE TREND momentum; AAPL to hold its 1M support to avoid sliding into CORRECTION; UNH needs follow-through above recent highs to confirm sector leadership; JPM must regain 1W momentum to resolve its CORRECTION status.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
QCOM (+65): Qualcomm (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +14.19%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price confirming on OpenAI chip coverage.  
TXN (+55): Texas Instruments (1W: +20.59% | 1M: +40.84%) ABOVE TREND — analyst upgrades confirming strong price action.  
UNP (+55): Union Pacific (1W: +6.99% | 1M: +11.34%) ABOVE TREND — Q1 margin beats confirmed by price.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
META (-50): Meta (1W: -1.96% | 1M: +13.47%) CORRECTION — negative headline but 1M strength suggests distribution; watch follow-through.  
XOM (-55): Exxon (1W: +1.69% | 1M: -8.79%) RECOVERY — legal headlines negative while 1W bounce creates a tactical watch for reversal failure.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime; style mixed / no clear leadership.  
AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +20.59% | 1M: +40.84%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND showing strength.  
Key risk: major divergence among large caps (META CORRECTION, several financials in CORRECTION) and mixed news sentiment — monitor for trend breaks and sentiment-driven distribution.
